verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own MCP server for operating the product in natural language. It lets users connect Ramp to assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to "query Ramp data and take actions with natural language." Documented actions include searching transactions, approving or rejecting transactions and reimbursements, editing records, asking policy questions, and making purchases, with role-based admin controls; example prompts are given and a probe confirms the live, OAuth-gated server. missing for 10: no evidenced native in-app natural-language command interface (operation goes through third-party assistants), bill approvals not yet available via MCP, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
